summary: Architectural review of the Strategy Lab and execution pipeline at source commit 08d56917cc11. No fresh runtime evidence (within 2 h) is available; profitability and canary/live readiness cannot be asserted. The existing strategy framework is sound in its safety separation (SHADOW-first, preflight, simulation gates), but several structural gaps reduce durable net P&L confidence and increase operational risk. Three proposals are raised: (1) introduce a calibrated positive-edge forecast layer to gate entries on net-cost-adjusted expected value rather than raw price direction; (2) add a cross-chain cost normalisation step so EVM and Solana opportunities are compared on equivalent net-P&L terms before a route is selected; (3) strengthen shadow-window sampling governance so a strategy cannot exit SHADOW on a sample smaller than the documented MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES / MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES thresholds.
runtime_evidence_gap: No runtime evidence file with a timestamp within 2 h of the review cycle was supplied. Gross P&L, profit factor, execution failure rates, and opportunity participation rates cannot be verified for this cycle. These gaps must be closed before any strategy can be declared LIVE-ready.

proposals.title: Calibrated positive-edge forecast gate
proposals.hypothesis: Entries gated on a calibrated expected-value forecast (net of fees, slippage and gas) rather than raw directional signal will reduce loss-making trades and improve profit factor without reducing eligible opportunity participation below 20 %.
proposals.shadow_test: Run the enhanced strategy in SHADOW for at least 3 evaluation windows each containing ≥ 8 trades. Pass threshold: profit factor ≥ 1.10 and money-weighted net P&L > 0 after all recorded costs. Fail if profit factor < 1.05 or participation rate < 0.20 on eligible opportunities.

evidence.note: MIN_PROFIT_FACTOR = 1.10 and MIN_ELIGIBLE_PARTICIPATION = 0.20 are defined but there is no pre-entry expected-value gate; all positive-edge filtering is post-hoc in window evaluation.
AI proposals are accepted into the registry with no calibration check on predicted edge vs. actual costs.

proposals.research_plan: Collect shadow trade outcomes per strategy family for the last 30 days from the strategy_lab_windows table. Compute money-weighted net P&L and profit factor per family. Cross-reference with opportunity eligibility logs to measure participation rate. Identify families with profit factor < 1.05 as primary candidates for forecast gating.

proposals.title: Cross-chain cost normalisation before route selection
proposals.hypothesis: Normalising EVM gas costs and Solana priority fees to a common net-P&L unit before route selection will prevent systematically over-selecting the cheaper-quoted but higher-cost chain, improving average trade net P&L.
proposals.shadow_test: Run both Solana and EVM shadow strategies through the normalised cost path for ≥ 3 evaluation windows each containing ≥ 8 trades per chain. Pass threshold: average net P&L per trade improves by ≥ 5 % vs. the preceding window on at least one chain without degrading the other below its current baseline profit factor.

evidence.note: Cross-chain signal generation does not apply a shared cost-normalisation step; EVM and Solana routes are evaluated in their native fee units.
Profit factor thresholds are chain-agnostic but the underlying P&L inputs are not cost-normalised across chains.

proposals.research_plan: Extract per-trade gas/fee records from both chains for the last 60 days. Build a cost normalisation mapping (SOL priority fee ↔ ETH gas in USD). Run a shadow replay comparing routed net P&L before and after normalisation.

proposals.title: Enforce minimum sample-size gates before SHADOW promotion
proposals.hypothesis: Enforcing strict enforcement of MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS (3), MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES (8) and MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES (10) as hard blocking gates in the promotion path will prevent under-sampled strategies from reaching PROBATION or ACTIVE status prematurely, reducing out-of-sample loss events.
proposals.shadow_test: Audit the promotion path in strategy_lab.py. Verify that no strategy reaches PROBATION without satisfying all three numeric thresholds. Introduce a regression test that attempts promotion with n=7 trades and asserts it is rejected. Pass: test suite green; no existing ACTIVE strategy has a window count below MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS.

evidence.note: MIN_EVALUATION_WINDOWS, MIN_EVALUATION_TRADES and MIN_ELIGIBLE_OPPORTUNITIES are defined as module constants but the promotion logic does not check all three atomically before advancing status.
Existing tests do not cover the edge case where all three sampling thresholds are individually met but the combined atomic check is bypassed via partial window completion.

proposals.research_plan: Read the full promote_strategy() / evaluate_and_promote() code path in strategy_lab.py. Map each threshold constant to its check site. Identify any code path where a strategy can advance without all three being satisfied.
